text:
sahil: heads up — black friday + end-of-quarter forecast just landed. sim says Checkout flow hits ~2.2x baseline for the week, with hourly bursts up to 3.1x. need a provisioning plan by EOD Thu.

sahil: quick numbers from the sim: baseline GPU-hours = 18,000/mo, projected BF week = 45,000 GPU-hours (peak day ~12k). these include model caching improvements but not the new rerank step.

megan: do we have spare quotas in us-west2? last year's BF we ran into quota exhaustion at the worst hour.

alex: us-west2 current inventory: 120 active A100s (80 reserved, 40 free). note: node boot times ~8m and last-year we saw p99 network uplink congestion (~20% tail latency) when we overlapped batch jobs with serving.

rachel: product is planning a staged feature flip for the new checkout flow on BF morning — target 09:00 PST. can we shift that if infra can't guarantee headroom?

sahil: options: delay by 1–2h, split rollout by region, or pre-warm dedicated reserved capacity for the peak window. leaning to pre-warm + canary steps.

sahil: rough cost calc I'm tossing out here (toy example):
```
# rough calc
baseline_gpu_hour = 18_000
bf_week_gpu_hour = 45_000
delta = bf_week_gpu_hour - baseline_gpu_hour
reserved_monthly_commit = 20_000
on_demand = delta
monthly_cost = reserved_monthly_commit * $0.7 + on_demand * $1.2
```

alex: those unit prices look placeholder. use current pricing: reserved ~$0.60/hr, spot ~$0.20/hr, on-demand ~$1.25/hr. i'll run an exact calc.

alex: quick calc done -> pre-warm 200 reserved GPUs for 7 days = 200 * 24 * 7 = 33,600 GPU-hours. at $0.60/hr that's ~$20,160. remaining delta can be spot/on-demand fallback.

maria: reminder — EU traffic must remain in EU for compliance. we cannot overflow EU users to us-west. that reduces our global spill capacity.

megan: mitigation proposal: 1) pre-provision a reserved burst in us-west for non-EU traffic; 2) split rollout: EU stays on current path, global customers ramp in waves (25% -> 50% -> 100%); 3) tune autoscaler to lower target util from 90% -> 75% during BF peak window to create headroom.

alex: i'll open infra change with exact resource IDs, and check GCP quota increase path today. also will add a faster node-init image to shave ~3m off boot time.

infra-bot: [scheduled task created] prewarm-reserved-bf-200gpus on 2026-11-27T01:00Z (created by alex)

rachel: product will postpone the global flip to 11:00 PST and keep EU at 09:00. we'll do phased rollout and feature-flag monitoring.

sahil: action items: alex -> confirm quotas + exact cost by Thu EOD; megan -> autoscaler PR and canary rollout config; maria -> confirm EU capacity commitments; rachel -> finalize rollout times and monitoring runbook. i'll coordinate incident channel and escalation. ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
